notes.title: This game is now FREE to own!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

[h3]it is time to give this game for free.[/h3]

Why?
[h3]so more people get to play it ;-)[/h3]

When?
Price tag has been removed and the game is[b] free to own[/b]. 
Store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/860550/Secrets_of_the_Past_Dion/

What happens with existing customers?
Nothing. You will of course keep the game if you have bought it.
